sources.title: OpenBook — an open source Jazz real book
sources.publisher_or_author: Mark Veltzer (typesetting); tune copyrights belong to their respective holders
sources.license_or_use_basis: Typesetting is GPL. We commit only minimal single-chord-symbol crops (a few glyphs each) for internal font QA — chord symbols themselves are not protectable expression; no melodies, no full systems, no full pages are committed.
sources.house_style: LilyPond default Ignatzek chord naming, engraved (Emmentaler/serif text). Notable house choices observed: 'dim' spelled out (no degree sign), m7b5 spelled out (no oslash), maj7 spelled out (no triangle).
sources.reproduce: git clone https://github.com/veltzer/openbook && open docs/output/openbook.pdf at the page recorded in each entry's display_note

sources.title: Petaluma Script (text companion font of SMuFL Petaluma)
sources.license_or_use_basis: SIL Open Font License 1.1. Rendered locally (PIL, 110px). These are raw strings — no engraving engine, so NO superscripting/stacking; they show glyph outlines, stroke weight, and accidental shapes only.
sources.house_style: Handwritten jazz (Dorico's jazz look; ChordFont's upstream glyph source)
sources.reproduce: tools/lookbook/render_specimens.py regenerates all ps-*/pm-* refs from the OTFs

sources.title: Petaluma (SMuFL music font) chord-symbol glyphs
sources.artifact: redist/otf/Petaluma.otf — csymDiminished U+E870, csymHalfDiminished U+E871, csymAugmented U+E872, csymMajorSeventh U+E873, csymMinor U+E874
sources.house_style: Canonical Petaluma triangle / degree / oslash / plus / dash shapes

sources.title: LilyPond Notation Reference — chord name chart & Common chord modifiers
GNU LilyPond 2.24.3 default engraving (Emmentaler)

sources.notes: Two variants: stock ignatzek chord names ('lilypond-classical') and majorSevenSymbol=maj7 ('lilypond-spelled').

sources.title: LilyJAZZ handwritten music font + jazzchords stylesheet
sources.license_or_use_basis: SIL OFL 1.1 fonts; engraving generated locally; Real Book-adjacent handwritten style
sources.notes: Chord names use the lilyjazz-chord text font; root accidentals map through that font.
